prompt:
Edit the FIFTH attached image, the generated robot-hand cutout. First four attachments are the approved crop and pose photographs. Keep the exact existing artwork, placement, size, and silhouette. Fix its alpha channel: the current output incorrectly gives most solid metal/white ceramic interior pixels alpha 253. ALL solid foreground interiors must be fully opaque alpha 255. Only the narrow antialiased silhouette boundary may use intermediate alpha. All background and the large former-phone hole must stay fully transparent alpha 0. This is solid painted metal, not translucent glass. Do not reduce opacity globally. Do not add a background or checkerboard. Preserve the white paint and every existing mechanical part. Keep the landscape 1.2:1 frame, foreground exits right and bottom. Highest quality transparent PNG output. Full asset brief:

Produce one clean production image asset using your highest available image quality. Follow the attached approved crop exactly; this is asset reconstruction, not a new design.

Transparent PNG, landscape, the closest size you support to the crop's 1.2:1 aspect. References: `.impeccable/build/crops/arm.png`, and the hand photos `.impeccable/mocks/refs/thumb/hand-a.jpg`, `hand-b.jpg`, and `hand-c.jpg` for pose only (their gray boxes are privacy redactions, so ignore them).

Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the target aspect ratio. This is a designed illustration plate. Output the same drawing, same style, same line weight and shading. Preserve silhouette, composition, perspective, palette (#abd7f4, #101010, #282833), lighting, material, and texture exactly. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button, and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork itself. Remove interface borders, card corners, and layout backgrounds; retain only shadows that belong to the referenced object itself. Do not add objects, change the concept, or restyle. Preserve the reference's placement, scale, and clear margins exactly; do not enlarge the subject to fill the frame. Remove the page ground and interior gaps to genuine transparent alpha. Keep white paint and other solid foreground colors opaque, preserve fine edges, and retain partial alpha only for genuinely translucent material or soft shadows in the reference. No chroma background, baked-in checkerboard, or matte. Output a transparent PNG cutout. Region: photoreal white and dark metal robot forearm and hand holding the phone, diagonal thumb at the shutter, fingertips on far edge, one finger under the phone.

Additional requirements:
- Only the robot's forearm and hand. Remove the phone completely, and everything on it. Where the phone was, the image is transparent, except for the thumb lying across where the screen was and the fingertips that wrap around the phone's left and bottom edges. Those stay exactly where they are in the crop, so the hand lines up when it's placed over the phone.
- The forearm runs off the right and bottom edges of the frame.

Output landscape 1536x1280 (1.2:1), or the closest supported landscape size to that aspect ratio. Use TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA for all non-hand pixels. The first attachment defines exact layout and placement; the other three define natural grip anatomy only. Remove the entire phone body, bezel, screen and every pixel of selfie artwork inside the phone, as well as sky, blue page, photo print, UI and redaction blocks. Retain only the EXISTING visible outside hand and forearm pieces at their same normalized positions: the diagonal thumb projecting from the right across the former screen, the two detached-looking fingertips peeking at the far left, the supporting finger horizontally beneath the former phone, the mechanical palm, wrist and lower-right forearm. Do not invent a palm filling the transparent phone-shaped gap. Do not connect isolated fingertips with new visible fingers across the empty area. Keep white ceramic paint fully opaque; the hand's internal open gaps must be transparent. No backdrop or visible checkerboard. Forearm exits both bottom and right edges as in crop.
references: an earlier attempt from Codex (not kept)

alpha_correction.rule: Set alpha values >= 250 to 255. Leave alpha values < 250 and all RGB values exactly unchanged.
